parameters.text:
={{ $json.body.agent_name }}, the goal of this prompt is to update a text generated by an LLM AI platform, which was later modified by a non-professional writer. The task is to refine only the modified sections to improve clarity and coherence while maintaining the original intent and flow. If the entire text was changed, rewrite it to preserve the main idea.

Instructions:

        1.        Identify the parts of the text that were modified by the user.
        2.        Update only the modified parts while keeping the original sections unchanged.
        3.        If the entire text was changed, rewrite it to maintain the main idea but improve clarity and coherence.
        4.        Ensure the new text flows naturally and maintains the original intent.

Here is the information to run the excercise:

Original Text: {{ $json.body.old_text }}

Modified Text: {{ $json.body.new_text }}


>>> Start of Examples on how to perform the action <<<

Original Text:
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. This action is often used to demonstrate the agility and speed of the fox.

Modified Text:
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. This example shows how fast the fox can be.

Updated Text:
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. This example demonstrates the agility and speed of the fox.

>>> End of Examples on how to perform the action <<<

Es obligatorio entregar  los resultados como un arreglo json con un solo elemento. 

[ { "Text" : [Texto mejorado y generado por el modelo LLM ] }]

No incluyas comentarios de entrada a la respuesta,ir directamente a la respuesta en formato JSON
